stepBody:
Three different training paradigms are used to optimize a model. Each runs for $$5$$ epochs.
• Paradigm $$1$$ (Batch GD): $$120$$ data points
• Paradigm $$2$$ (Mini-batch GD): $$100$$ data points, batch size of $$20$$
• Paradigm $$3$$ (Stochastic GD): $$10$$ data points
Which ordering correctly ranks the paradigms by total number of gradient computations across all epochs?
